create_binary_classifier_curve_display: create a binary classifier curve display (e.g. ROC curve) from an estimator and test data using from_estimator
create_curve_display_from_predictions: create a curve display from true labels and predicted probabilities or decisions using from_predictions
create_curve_display_from_cv_results: create a curve display from cross-validation results with return_estimator and return_indices enabled
validate_style_kwargs: validate matplotlib style kwargs by resolving shorthand aliases (e.g. 'c' to 'color') and raising on conflicts
validate_score_name: validate and normalize a scoring metric name, handling neg_ prefix and callable scorers
